articles.summary: Silvia has become the leading personal finance AI product Within two months of launching monetization, more than 10% of Silvia's monthly active users are paying members Power users have seen typical net worth gains of 16-41% in less than a year on the platform NEW YORK --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul.
articles.title: Silvia Surpasses $50 Billion in Assets in 14 Months Since Public Launch
